fee_notes: Royalty: 9% of Monthly Total Net Revenues due 15th of month. Advertising Contribution: 1% of Monthly Total Net Revenues due 15th of month. Local Advertising Obligation: 4% or 5% of prior year's Annual Net Revenue depending on growth >5%. Note: Effective April 2024, total Royalties & Ad Fund Contributions increased from 8% to 10% for new franchise agreements.
raw_excerpt: Royalty 9% of Monthly Total Net Revenues, plus possible gross-up for state or local taxes. Advertising Contribution 1% of Monthly Total Net Revenues. Local Advertising Obligation 4% or 5% of the prior Calendar Year's Annual Net Revenue depending on if you increased your Annual Net Revenue by 5% over the prior Calendar Year.
